newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian teachers to strike over wages, benefits.
newsitem.headline: Croatian teachers to strike over wages, benefits.

text.p: A trade union of Croatian school teachers said on Monday it would stage one strike every week, beginning on February 20, unless the government signed a long-delayed collective salary agreement with the union.
Vesna Kanizaj, head of the union, said they would first stage a warning, five-minute strike on February 20, state news agency HINA reported.

Classes would be briefly suspended during the second, one-hour strike on February 27, while the next strike would last the whole day. Public rallies and protests would start on March 10, Kanizaj said.
However, the union would take no measures if the government agreed to sign the collective agreement, regulating school teachers' salaries and other benefits, on Tuesday, she said.
